question: For the calendar year 2021, what is the overall average quantity sold of the top three best-selling hardware products (by total quantity sold) in each division?
sql:
-- Final query: average of total quantities for top 3 products per division
WITH product_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        p.division,
        h.product_code,
        SUM(h.sold_quantity) AS total_qty
    FROM hardware_fact_sales_monthly h
    JOIN hardware_dim_product p ON h.product_code = p.product_code
    WHERE h.fiscal_year = 2021
    GROUP BY p.division, h.product_code
),
ranked_products AS (
    SELECT 
        division,
        product_code,
        total_qty,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY division ORDER BY total_qty DESC) AS rn
    FROM product_totals
)
SELECT 
    division,
    AVG(total_qty) AS avg_quantity_sold
FROM ranked_products
WHERE rn <= 3
GROUP BY division
ORDER BY division

-- Final query: average of total quantities for top 3 products per division
WITH product_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        p.division,
        h.product_code,
        SUM(h.sold_quantity) AS total_qty
    FROM hardware_fact_sales_monthly h
    JOIN hardware_dim_product p ON h.product_code = p.product_code
    WHERE h.fiscal_year = 2021
    GROUP BY p.division, h.product_code
),
ranked_products AS (
    SELECT 
        division,
        product_code,
        total_qty,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY division ORDER BY total_qty DESC) AS rn
    FROM product_totals
)
SELECT 
    division,
    AVG(total_qty) AS avg_quantity_sold
FROM ranked_products
WHERE rn <= 3
GROUP BY division
ORDER BY division
